_comment: Every message the client shows, by key (M7-06). Values are str.format templates: {name} is filled in by the game. Another language = another file next to this one (pt.json…) with the same keys; missing keys fall back to English.
act.opened: The road is open: {town} joins your waypoints.
art.inBackground: The art keeps downloading in the background; sprites appear when it ends.
art.missingFiles: {count} art/sound file(s) missing (magenta squares, silence). Run: python -m aethelgard.tools.fetch_art
art.retryLater: Missing sprites show as magenta squares. Retry: python -m aethelgard.tools.fetch_art
bar.emptyKey: Key {key} is empty: click the slot to choose a skill.
bar.noRight: Right click has no skill: right-click one in the trees (T).
bar.rightHint: Right click: right-click a skill in the trees, or drag one here.
characters.cannotDeletePlaying: You cannot delete the character you are playing: change character first.
loot.backpackFull: Backpack full: {text} stays on the ground.
